label: Purpose
text: Track awareness, usage, consideration and advertising recall for six streaming services, wave on wave.
raw_text: Purpose: Track awareness, usage, consideration and advertising recall for six streaming services, wave on wave.

label: Method
raw_text: Method: Online self-completion. Continuous monthly tracker.

label: Sample
text: 600 adults aged 18 and over who watch video content at least weekly, nationally representative on age (18-34: 35%), region and gender.
